Hero.body: Upload your design, choose your garment, and we'll embroider it with precision — stitch by stitch, thread by thread.

HowItWorks.step1Desc: Select from our curated collection of premium shirts, hoodies, caps, totes, and more — all embroidery-ready and pre-washed.
HowItWorks.step2Desc: Upload your artwork, logo, or text. Our software converts it into stitch patterns — or choose from our curated library of motifs.
HowItWorks.step3Desc: Our artisans review each order and embroider your design using professional-grade machines with 40+ thread colors available.
HowItWorks.step4Desc: Your custom piece arrives in our signature packaging within 5–7 business days, ready to wear or gift.

WhyChooseUs.reason1Desc: Every piece is reviewed and finished by hand so your design looks beautiful and lasts longer.
WhyChooseUs.reason1Detail: Precision stitching, premium threads, and artisan care on every order.
WhyChooseUs.reason2Desc: Custom embroidery that ships in 5–7 days, with tracking and premium packaging included.
WhyChooseUs.reason2Detail: From upload to delivery, we keep your order moving without rushing the finish.
WhyChooseUs.reason3Desc: Need help preparing artwork or choosing colors? Our team guides you every step of the way.
WhyChooseUs.reason3Detail: Upload a design, or ask for design review before we start stitching.

Footer.tagline: Custom embroidery built for personal stories, small brands, and one-of-a-kind pieces.

ProcessPage.heroBody: Every ThreadCraft piece follows the same four-step journey — from your first click to the moment it arrives at your door, hand-finished and ready to wear.

steps.label: Select garment
steps.title: Choose your garment
steps.desc: Browse our curated collection of embroidery-ready garments — pre-washed, pre-shrunk, and selected for how well they hold a stitch.
details: Hoodies, sweatshirts, t-shirts, caps, tote bags and more
Multiple colors per garment, shown in real product photos
All garments are embroidery-grade — no cheap blanks
Size guide available on every product page

steps.label: Design studio
steps.title: Design in the studio
steps.desc: Open the live design studio and place your embroidery exactly where you want it. Drag, resize, and preview in real time.
details: Choose from our curated motif library — sun, anchor, waves and more
Upload your own logo or artwork (PNG, SVG, JPG up to 20MB)
Add custom text in multiple font styles
Pick from 40+ thread colors, applied to any layer individually

steps.label: Production
steps.title: We embroider it
steps.desc: Our artisans review every order individually. Your design is digitized into a stitch file, then embroidered with professional-grade machines.
details: Every order reviewed by a human before production starts
Professional embroidery machines — not heat transfer or print
Complex logos are hand-digitized for stitch accuracy
Quality check before packaging — we don't ship flawed pieces

steps.label: Delivery
steps.title: Delivered to you
steps.desc: Your piece arrives in our signature packaging within 5–7 business days. Ready to wear, gift, or send directly to your team.
details: Signature ThreadCraft packaging — makes a great gift
Ships worldwide, tracking included on every order
Bulk orders for teams and businesses — contact us for pricing

guarantees.title: Satisfaction guarantee
guarantees.desc: If your piece arrives with a defect or doesn't match your design, we redo it — no questions, no fees.

guarantees.title: Embroidery, not print
guarantees.desc: Every design is stitched directly into the fabric. It won't peel, fade, or crack — it outlasts the garment itself.

guarantees.title: Revisions before production
guarantees.desc: We send a digital proof before we start embroidering. You approve it — then we stitch.

faqs.q: What file formats can I upload?
faqs.a: PNG, SVG, and JPG up to 20MB. For best results, use a PNG with a transparent background or a clean SVG. Avoid low-resolution images — the embroidery will only be as sharp as your file.
5–7 business days from the moment you place your order. Rush orders are available — contact us before ordering and we'll confirm availability.

faqs.q: Can I order for my team or business?
faqs.a: Yes. We do bulk orders for corporate uniforms, sports teams, clinics, and branded merchandise. Contact us for pricing — bulk orders get a discount.

faqs.q: What if I don't like the result?
faqs.a: We send a digital proof before production. If the finished piece has a defect or doesn't match what you approved, we redo it at no cost.
Yes — we ship worldwide. Shipping times and costs vary by destination and are shown at checkout before you pay.

faqs.q: Can I embroider on something I already own?
faqs.a: Not yet — we only embroider on garments from our own collection. This ensures the fabric is compatible with our machines and gives consistent results.

AboutPage.intro: At THREADcraft, we bring wardrobe dreams to life with embroidery that feels personal, intentional, and elevated. Every piece is designed with the textures, colors, and spirit of modern craftsmanship in mind.

pillars.label: Our mission
pillars.title: Elevate everyday essentials.
pillars.body: We create embroidered apparel that turns simple garments into meaningful statements. From custom logos to unique thread details, our work is made to be worn, treasured, and shared.

pillars.label: Our process
pillars.title: Crafted one stitch at a time.
pillars.body: Every design begins with thoughtful concepting, followed by careful embroidery and quality review. We pair traditional technique with modern styling so every result feels both timeless and fresh.

pillars.label: Our promise
pillars.title: Built to last.
pillars.body: From premium fabrics to durable thread, we take pride in results that look beautiful and stand the test of wear. Your custom order is completed with care, precision, and attention to every detail.

AboutPage.whyParagraph1: We believe meaningful apparel should be personal, not generic. That means listening to your story, refining the design, and delivering a finished piece that feels unmistakably yours.
AboutPage.whyParagraph2: Whether you want a custom logo, embroidered text, or a fully bespoke look, our studio is built to make your vision feel effortless and beautifully executed.

values.title: Thoughtful craftsmanship
values.body: Every stitch is chosen with care, and every garment is finished with quality in mind.

values.title: Personal service
values.body: We help you bring your idea to life with a simple process and close collaboration.

values.title: Sustainable detail
values.body: Long-lasting products, carefully made using better materials and mindful production.
